messages.subject: Project Indigo - Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Good to speak. Please find attached the heads of terms for Project Indigo reflecting where we landed on the call: exclusive in the commercial-aviation field for five years, £4.5m upfront, milestones up to £18m, tiered royalties 5/8/11% with a £1.2m minimum from year 3. These are subject to contract save for the binding paragraphs. Grateful for any comments.

James

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Indigo - Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thanks. Broadly fine to progress to long-form. Two flags from Aerelon for the drafting: (1) the minimum annual royalty feels high at this stage of deployment; and (2) we'll want the liability position revisited. We'll pick these up on the mark-up. Happy to confirm exclusivity to 31 March.

Alistair
Pemberton Rowe LLP
